mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_tax_evidence (id, calculation_id, evidence_type, source_code, country_code, subdivision_code, validation_status, result_code, checked_at, create_time) VALUES
(#{row.id}, #{row.calculationId}, #{row.evidenceType}, #{row.sourceCode}, #{row.countryCode}, #{row.subdivisionCode}, #{row.validationStatus}, #{row.resultCode}, #{row.checkedAt}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, calculation_id, evidence_type, source_code, country_code, subdivision_code, validation_status, result_code, checked_at, create_time FROM t_tax_evidence WHERE calculation_id IN #{v} ORDER BY calculation_id, evidence_type
